info.title: Mantua trading quote
info.description: Pre-trade quote for one outcome-token market trade, with remaining daily cap. x402-priced service. Unpaid requests receive 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED with both rails in one accepts array: Circle Gateway nanopayments and vanilla exact x402 on eip155:8453 (Base Mainnet). Typed refusals after payment (cap_blocked, BETTING_CLOSED, TRADING_HALTED, NO_MARKET) are definitive answers — the request was purchased.

servers.description: Mantua API root — prepend the deployment origin.

post.summary: Pre-trade quote for one outcome-token market trade, with remaining daily cap
post.description: Quotes one trade on Base without issuing calldata — the same builder the calldata service executes against. Buys run a read-only spending-cap check (a quote never inks the ledger); the response carries the payer's remaining daily headroom so an agent can size against its own cap state. The caller signs all calldata with its own wallet — the server holds no keys and executes nothing.

200.description: The quote plus the payer's remaining daily cap headroom

yesToken.description: The YES token address for this market.

quote.description: The v4 quoter's quote for the trade at the current pool state.

fee.description: The hook fee applied to the trade.

capRemainingUsd.description: The paying wallet's remaining daily spending-cap headroom in USD.

402.description: Payment required — see PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. The header lists both rails in one accepts array: Circle Gateway nanopayments (gasless, batch-settled) and vanilla exact x402 on eip155:8453.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64url JSON carrying the accepts[] payment requirements for both rails.

403.description: The trade is refused by the paying wallet's daily spending cap (cap_blocked) — the body carries the cap, spend, and requested amounts.

404.description: No market exists for this game yet (NO_MARKET).

409.description: Betting on this game is closed (BETTING_CLOSED).

502.description: Couldn't quote this trade — the pool may lack liquidity at this size (QUOTE_FAILED).

503.description: Service dark by configuration (X402_SERVICE_DISABLED), the in-play feed is down and new buys are halted (TRADING_HALTED), or the market stack is not deployed on this chain (MARKETS_NOT_DEPLOYED).

TradeRequest.description: The browser trade shape minus chainId — trading happens on Base, the settlement network.

providerEventId.description: Provider event id of the game to trade.

outcomeIndex.description: 0 = home market, 1 = away market — whose YES the caller is trading.

direction.description: "buy" spends USDC for YES; "sell" spends YES for USDC.

amountRaw.description: Exact input in raw units (6 dp): USDC for buys, YES tokens for sells. Must be > 0 and ≤ 100000000000.

slippageBps.description: Execution price bound in bps — becomes the on-chain slippage guard. Defaults to the house default; hard-capped at 500 (5.0%).

CapBlockedBody.description: A trade refused by the paying wallet's daily spending cap (C-019, keyed to the settling payer).
